name: Yandere Simulator: Rise of Evil
source:
It is time for the Rise of Evil.

You are a new, and normal student in Akademi High School. Everything is normal: It is a normal High School like every other school. However... What happens when there is a killer between the students?
This girl is a killer. She does not care if you are suffering or not. It doesn't matter if you are a boy or a girl. If you are near Taro Yamada (Senpai), you will be dead. What will you do? Will you call the police? How can you get evidence that there is a killer in Akademi High School? It is all in your hands in Yandere Simulator: Rise of Evil - The Visual Novel.

YOU IN THE YANDERE SIMULATOR WORLD: Be part of Akademi High School in this game.

INTERACT: Talk with characters such as Senpai, Kokona, Osana, and etc.

CHOOSE YOUR DESTINY: You make your own choices in Rise of Evil - The Visual Novel. Be careful: If you choose the wrong thing, you may... Die.

[From [url=http://gamejolt.com/games/yandere-simulator-rise-of-evil-the-visual-novel/149466]GameJolt[/url]]

Yandere Simulator fan game.
translation:
邪恶崛起的时刻到了。

你是Akademi高中的一名普通新生。一切都很正常：这是一所与其他学校并无二致的普通高中。然而……如果学生中藏着一个杀人凶手，会发生什么？
这个女孩就是凶手。她不在乎你是否痛苦，也不在乎你是男是女。只要你接近山田太郎，也就是“学长”，你就会死。你会怎么办？报警吗？你又该如何找到证据，证明Akademi高中里藏着杀人凶手？在《病娇模拟器：邪恶崛起》视觉小说版中，一切都掌握在你手中。

走进《病娇模拟器》的世界：在本作中，成为Akademi高中的一员。

互动：与学长、心菜、Osana等角色交谈。

选择你的命运：在《邪恶崛起》视觉小说版中，由你做出自己的选择。小心，选错的话，你可能会……死。

（来源：[url=http://gamejolt.com/games/yandere-simulator-rise-of-evil-the-visual-novel/149466]GameJolt[/url]）

《病娇模拟器》的同人游戏。
